purpose: The things that go wrong, or get awkward, in an online store that neither the shopper nor the store owner will think to specify. For each one: what the shopper sees, what the owner sees, what the default behavior is, and whether a test proves it. This file is the reusable part: every store of this type starts from it, and every incident adds to it.

status.handled: The app has defined behavior for this and the shopper and owner both get a clear experience.
status.partial: The app copes, but someone is left unaware, or only part of the situation is covered.
status.open: Not handled. The owner has a decision to make, or it needs a feature the current specs exclude.

tested.yes: An automated check in e2e/ proves it.
tested.partial: Part of the behavior is checked.
tested.no: Built in, but no automated check yet.

how_to_read.owner_decision: Choices the store owner should make in plain language, with the default marked. Never ask the owner a technical question.

edges.edge: Shopper tries to add a product without choosing a required option.
edges.shopper_sees: A message naming the missing choice ("Please choose a glaze before adding to your cart"), and focus moves to that option.
edges.default_behavior: Block the add. Keep everything else the shopper chose.

edges.edge: Shopper picks a combination that is sold out.
edges.shopper_sees: The option is struck through and labelled "Sold out". If they add anyway, a message says that combination is sold out and their other choices are kept.
edges.default_behavior: Block the add and explain.

edges.edge: Personalization text is too long or uses unsupported characters.
edges.shopper_sees: A specific message (limit, or which characters are allowed) next to the field, plus a live character count.
edges.default_behavior: Reject the text. Letters, numbers, spaces and & . , ' - only; limit set per product.

edges.edge: Personalization contains only spaces.
edges.shopper_sees: The item is added with no personalization.
edges.default_behavior: Trim and collapse whitespace; an empty result means no personalization (and the item stays returnable).
tests: E-004 spaces-only engraving is not stored as personalization

edges.edge: Shopper opens a link to a product that does not exist.
edges.shopper_sees: "We couldn't find that product" with a path back to the shop.
edges.default_behavior: 404 with a recovery path.

edges.edge: Shopper opens a bookmarked link to a product that is no longer for sale.
edges.shopper_sees: "This piece isn't available right now" with a link to the shop. No add-to-cart button.
edges.default_behavior: Hide from the catalog; the direct link explains instead of showing an error.
tests: E-006 unavailable product has no add-to-cart button

edges.edge: Shopper adds more of an item than the per-item maximum (10).
edges.shopper_sees: A message saying they already have 10 and what to do. No false "Added" confirmation. (Before 2026-10-16 the add was silently ignored while the page said "Added to your cart".)
edges.default_behavior: Cap at 10 per line and say so.
tests: E-007 cart line reaches the maximum of 10
E-007 increase button disabled at the maximum
E-007 adding beyond the maximum explains why
E-007 no false 'Added to your cart' confirmation
edges.found_by: edge review of the reference build

owner_decision.question: What's the most of one item a shopper can buy at once?

edges.edge: Same product added twice, or two versions of it (different option or different engraving).
edges.shopper_sees: Identical items combine into one line with a higher quantity. Different options or engraving stay as separate lines.
edges.owner_sees: Each configuration is a separate line on the order.
edges.default_behavior: A line is product + option choices + personalization.
tests: cart has 3 distinct lines (merged identical, kept distinct configs)

edges.edge: Shopper tries to take a quantity below 1.
edges.shopper_sees: The minus button is disabled at 1. Removing is a separate, labelled action.
edges.default_behavior: Quantity is 1-10; Remove deletes the line.

edges.edge: Shopper's browser blocks storage (private mode, strict settings).
edges.shopper_sees: The cart works for this visit. It is not saved if they close the tab, and nothing tells them that.
edges.owner_sees: Nothing. These shoppers lose carts without anyone knowing.
edges.default_behavior: Fall back to an in-memory cart.
tests: E-010 cart works for this visit when storage is blocked
E-010 no crash when storage is blocked
edges.gap: Add a one-line notice ("Your cart won't be saved if you close this tab") when storage is unavailable.

edges.edge: Shopper has the store open in two tabs.
edges.shopper_sees: The cart count and contents stay in sync across tabs.
edges.default_behavior: Sync on browser storage events.
tests: E-011 other tab's cart count updates without reload

edges.edge: Owner changes a price while the item is already in someone's cart.
edges.shopper_sees: The cart keeps showing the old price until checkout, where the new price is caught (see E-017).
edges.default_behavior: Prices are re-checked at checkout; the browser cart is never trusted.
edges.gap: The cart page itself should refresh prices on load so shoppers aren't surprised at the last step.

owner_decision.question: When you change a price, what should happen to carts that already have the item?
options: Update the cart right away and tell the shopper
Honor the old price for 24 hours

edges.edge: Removing an item drops the order below the free-shipping amount.
edges.shopper_sees: Shipping appears, and the totals agree on the cart and checkout pages.
edges.default_behavior: One shared function computes shipping and totals for cart, checkout and the saved order.
edges.notes: Subtotal agreement is tested; crossing the free-shipping threshold is not.

owner_decision.question: What are your shipping charges and free-shipping amount?

edges.edge: Shopper reaches checkout with an empty cart.
edges.shopper_sees: "There's nothing to check out yet" with a link to the shop.
edges.default_behavior: No form is shown.

edges.edge: Contact or shipping details are missing or invalid.
edges.shopper_sees: A summary of problems that links to each field, a message under each field, and everything they typed is kept.
edges.default_behavior: Validate on the shopper's device and again on the server.

edges.edge: An item in the cart becomes unavailable before the shopper places the order.
edges.shopper_sees: A message naming the item, with a Remove button. No order is created.
edges.default_behavior: The server re-checks every line against the database.

edges.edge: A price changed between adding to the cart and placing the order.
edges.shopper_sees: Their summary updates, and they are asked to review and place the order again. No order is created at the old price.
edges.default_behavior: The server prices every line itself.

edges.edge: Shopper double-clicks Place order, goes back and resubmits, or the network retries.
edges.shopper_sees: One order, one confirmation.
edges.default_behavior: Each cart carries a one-time token; the same token always returns the same order.
edges.notes: The database enforces uniqueness, but no check yet submits the same token twice at once.

edges.edge: The database or network fails while the order is being placed.
edges.shopper_sees: "Something went wrong placing your demo order. Nothing was charged. Please try again."
edges.owner_sees: Nothing. The failure is only in a server log nobody reads.
edges.default_behavior: Fail safely; never create half an order (it is one transaction).
edges.gap: Tell the owner when checkout fails, in plain words, with what to try.

owner_decision.question: Where should we tell you when checkout stops working?
options: Show it on my dashboard only

edges.edge: Shopper refreshes or revisits the confirmation page.
edges.shopper_sees: The same confirmation.
edges.default_behavior: The confirmation page only reads; it never creates.

edges.edge: Shopper mistypes or loses their order reference.
edges.shopper_sees: "We couldn't find that order" with the format to look for and a path back to the shop.
edges.default_behavior: 404 with guidance.

edges.edge: A product is edited, repriced or deleted after it was ordered.
edges.shopper_sees: Their confirmation still shows what they bought, at the price they paid.
edges.default_behavior: Each order stores its own copy of names, options and prices.

edges.edge: Two shoppers buy the last piece at the same time.
edges.shopper_sees: Both succeed. One of them is let down later.
edges.default_behavior: None. "Sold out" is a switch the owner flips by hand; the store keeps no stock numbers.

owner_decision.question: How does stock work for each product?
options: One-of-a-kind: only one can ever be sold
Made to order: always available, with the lead time shown
Counted stock: numbers go down with each order and it sells out at zero

edges.edge: Owner re-runs the seed script on a live store.
edges.shopper_sees: Products they were looking at may vanish or change.
edges.owner_sees: Every catalog change they made is gone. (Past orders survive.)
edges.default_behavior: None. The script wipes and reloads the catalog without asking.
edges.gap: Refuse to reseed a store that already has products unless the owner explicitly confirms.

owner_decision.question: Should we stop you from accidentally wiping your product catalog?
options: Yes, ask me to confirm first (recommended)

edges.edge: The database is unreachable when pages load.
edges.shopper_sees: "The shop is having a moment" with Try again, and a reminder their cart is saved.
edges.default_behavior: A friendly error page instead of a stack trace.
edges.gap: Same owner alert as E-019, plus a status check the owner can open to see what's wrong.

edges.edge: Owner wants to see, manage or fulfil orders.
edges.shopper_sees: Their confirmation says nothing will ship (demo).
edges.owner_sees: No way to list or update orders. Statuses never change.
edges.default_behavior: None. A seller dashboard is outside the current specs.

owner_decision.question: How do you want to see your orders?
options: Emailed to me as they arrive

edges.edge: A real order is placed and nobody is told.
edges.shopper_sees: No confirmation email.
edges.default_behavior: None. Email is outside the current specs; the confirmation page says no email is sent.

owner_decision.question: Who should be emailed when an order comes in?

edges.edge: A shopper asks to cancel, or is owed a refund.
edges.shopper_sees: The returns page says to email the studio.
edges.owner_sees: No tool to cancel an order or record a refund.
edges.default_behavior: None. The returns policy is text only.

owner_decision.question: How should cancellations and refunds be handled?
options: A cancel button before the order ships

implementation_guidance.instruction: Treat each edge as expected behavior to preserve. When a new failure is found in any store of this type, add an entry here, add a check to e2e/, and mark its status honestly. Ask the owner only the owner_decision questions, in their own words.
